get.description:
Lists raw tag values matching a case-sensitive prefix for conversations autocomplete.

### Allowed Auth Scopes

- insights:ListConversationsTags
- insights:read

parameters.name: tagPrefix
parameters.description: Case-sensitive tag prefix used to filter autocomplete results.

schema.description: Case-sensitive tag prefix used to filter autocomplete results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of matching tags to return. Defaults to 10.

schema.description: Maximum number of matching tags to return. Defaults to 10.

key.description: The value for this bucket. For example, 'INBOUND' if grouping by direction, or '0-5min' if grouping by duration.

count.description: Number of conversations falling into this bucket.

buckets.description: A custom list of buckets to use for the duration aggregation. If not provided, default buckets will be used.
The list of buckets generated for this aggregation level.

id.description: Identity of this emission. Annotations are applied once per id: re-sending one already recorded on the conversation is ignored.

key.description: Identity of the value, when the annotation is one reading of something that changes over the conversation. See AnnotationKey.

AnnotationMetricValue.description:
A named value observed during the conversation, and the reading it replaces — a CSAT score, a
    talk ratio, the outcome of an evaluation. Emitted with an `AnnotationKey`, which is what makes
    the newest reading addressable in `annotationsByKey` while the series stays in `annotations`.

    Runtime services enforce serialized payload size limits.

value.description: The reading, as its producer models it: a score, a label, a number, or an object such as `{"customerRatio": 0.42, "agentRatio": 0.58}`.

previous.description: The reading this one replaces, so a consumer can render the change without loading the history. Absent on the first reading.

label.description: Human-readable name of the value, e.g. 'CSAT' or 'Talk ratio'.

AnnotationResultValue.description: Tool result captured for an annotation. Runtime services enforce serialized payload size limits.

AnnotationSource.description: Producer of an annotation. Generic identifiers allow callers to attach context such as tool id/name, user id/name, etc., without constraining the source type to a fixed shape.

id.description: Stable identifier of the producer (e.g. tool id, user id, copilot session id).

name.description: Human-readable name of the producer (e.g. tool name, user display name).

AnnotationVariablesValue.description: Capability variable values captured for an annotation. Runtime services enforce serialized payload size limits.

propertyNames.description:
Identity of the *value* an annotation carries, as opposed to `Annotation.id`, which identifies
    one emission of it. Two annotations sharing a key are two readings of the same thing — a CSAT
    score that moved, a talk ratio recomputed — so the conversation exposes the newest of them in
    `annotationsByKey` while every reading stays in `annotations`.

    Namespaced by producer to keep keys collision-free across annotation sources, e.g.
    `copilot.csat`, `copilot.talk_ratio`, `copilot.evaluation.objection_handled`. An annotation
    without a key is a one-off record and is not projected.

AnnotationsMap.description:
The newest annotation per `AnnotationKey`: the current value of everything the conversation
    tracks, without reading the history. Keyed annotations only — a one-off annotation appears
    solely in `annotations`.

error.description: Text with the reason for the error in case of unsuccessful fax delivery

sipCallId.description: A unique identifier for the SIP call session used to control the call e.g., answer, hold, transfer, hang up.

publicAddress.description: Represents a network endpoint consisting of a public IP address and a port number. Example: '123.45.67.89:59317'

privateAddress.description: Represents a network endpoint consisting of a private IP address and a port number. Example: '172.16.1.2:54003'

location.description: The location specifies a geographic point using latitude and longitude coordinates. Example 'lat=29.3008&lon=1.7002'

connectTime.description: Duration when the called party's phone rang (Ring Time in UI)

talkTime.description: Duration of conversation from the moment the call is answered until it ends, excluding hold time

waitTime.description: Duration spent on IVR, dialplan applications, playback, etc. before the call is answered

queueTime.description: Duration of call waiting in queue

holdTime.description: Duration the call was on hold after being answered

duration.description: Total duration = connectTime + waitTime + queueTime + talkTime + holdTime

queuePosition.description: Position of the call in the queue (1-based). Updated from consume events and emitted on live progress and record flows.

autoTranscribe.description: Indicates if a conference in the channel starts transcription automatically. When absent, clients follow autoRecord, which used to start both recording and transcription.

channelId.description: Direct-channel ids are the 8-4-4-4-8 slices of the two member ids. An `a_` member id puts `_` in a slice, so the pattern allows it.

broadcastId.description: A unique identifier of x-hoppers broadcast conference. If present x-hoppers application will use broadcast and push-to-talk functionality for the channel.

ChannelMessagingStatus.description: Set when classound refused a reply because the person's messaging window is closed (a 409 on the send). Unset by the next inbound message, which is the only thing that reopens the window.

id.description: A unique chat channel identifier, distinguish each chat channel across different types.

chatId.description: A unique identifier that distinguishes each chat session within a channel.

jid.description: A unique identifier to avoid duplicates if user re-connect from different devices.
